answer_1.quote: Empirically, ScaleBiO outperforms popular data filtering/reweighting baselines, including uniform sampling, LESS , and RHO-LOSS , surpassing them by a non-trivial margin of 1% -9% in GSM8K and MATH . This superiority of ScaleBiO also holds in instruction following tasks.
answer_1.outputs: Generated responses for instruction following and solutions for mathematical reasoning

answer_2.quote: As shown in Table , ScaleBiO consistently outperforms the baseline methods across the three benchmarks under the pass@1 metric. For the Cons@64 accuracy, ScaleBiO achieves performance comparable to the baselines.

answer_3.quote: Setup Three ∼7B-sized LLMs, including Llama-3-8B , Qwen-2-7B , and Gemma-2-9B are evaluated in the widely adopted benchmark of MT-Bench , where a GPT-4o judge is employed to score the generated responses of each model on 80 highquality multi-turn questions. Different aspects of the model, such as writing, role play, and STEM, are scored by the GPT-4o judge and averaged in the final MT-Bench score.
